_doc: The perspective ('inside') view a world can opt into with a `view` block in its spec ({"projection": "perspective", ...}), deep-merged over this. Camera numbers are world units (see ViewProjection): height = eye height, back = how far behind you the camera stands, pitch_deg = tilt down, shift = lens shift down the screen, far = draw distance ahead of you. `linger_camera` is where standing still settles it. Swing and linger feed ViewRig. Textures: the flat ground is rendered into a sharp near texture (out to near_reach ahead of you) and a wide far one.
